title: Market Sprint and its leaderboard
problem: There is no short daily format to retry and compare; the Daily market takes 8 to 14 days.
scope: Market Sprint: 3 days, 4 stalls, the day's shared seed, fixed shopkeepers and cash, the Daily's computer rivals, no upgrades or standing orders
Beside the Daily market on the Daily card, each labelled with its length
Score by final cash, then fruit sold; results with your best, your place, one concrete reason from the game, and Try again
A Sprint board per day, checked by server replay; your place, the top 10 and your neighbours; a weekly Sprint ranking
Run time measured in the browser and reported
exclusions: No rule, price or card changes; rules version 20
The Daily market itself and online play unchanged

acceptance.text: npm run verify with Sprint set-up, replay and ranking tests
npm run test:e2e plus a Sprint played and retried, run time reported
